tasks.label: Deploy server to AWS Lambda
tasks.command: npm run clean && mkdir -p dist/db && npx esbuild lambda.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs && cp db/budget-seed-data.csv dist/db/budget-seed-data.csv && (cd dist && zip -r ../server.zip .) && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name expense-tracker --zip-file fileb://server.zip --region us-east-2 --profile expense-tracker
